post.description:
Create the template your jobs run under: how candidates are reached, when, and which checks run by default. Only `name` and `schedule` are required. Returns `workflow_id`.

**Scope:** `workflows:write` · **Idempotency-Key:** optional

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first answer (kept 24 h). Leave empty in Try it: a new one is made for every call.

external_id.description: Your own id (1 to 128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -)

status.description: archived is reached only through DELETE

default_methods.description: Methods a mandate uses when it does not send its own

days.description: Days messages may go out, each listed once

schedule.description: Required. Send all six: `start_time` and `end_time` ("HH:MM"), `days` (mon…sun, at least one), `timezone` (IANA), `max_retries` 1 to 3, `retry_after_hours` 6, 8 or 12.

type.description: scenario-questions = the scenario question round; ai-phone-call = the AI phone call

verification_methods.description: Read-only: Record switches both methods on for every workflow, so you do not send it. Empty only on a workflow created before this field was stored.

is_external.description: true when the workflow was created through the Partner API, false when it was made in the Record playground

400.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: `name` or `schedule` missing, a `schedule` key missing, empty or repeated `days`, time not HH:MM, or an unknown field.

409.description: `CONFLICT`: `external_id` is already used by another workflow.

post.description:
Create the job Record verifies candidates against. Returns `mandate_id`; questions are prepared in the background.

**Scope:** `mandates:write` · **Idempotency-Key:** optional

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first answer (kept 24 h). Leave empty in Try it: a new one is made for every call.

location_type.description: Where the job is: "india" (default; give `location`) or "abroad" (give `countries`). Same as the playground's Abroad option

location.description: A place in India (find it with GET /locations). Leave it out for an abroad job

countries.description: Only with location_type "abroad": 1 to 10 ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes such as SG (list them with GET /countries). India is not selectable

description.description: Up to 1,500 characters (the question generator's limit)

shift.description: Use a value from GET /shifts so the playground shows it as a choice; any other text is kept as sent

employment_type.description: Use a value from GET /employment-types so the playground shows it as a choice; any other text is kept as sent

owner.description: The recruiter in your ATS; defaults to x-on-behalf-of

methods.description: Any non-empty mix; candidates always go enrichment → skills → interest. Omit to use the workflow's default.

verify.description: At most 3 per mandate, and only verifiable skills

pending.description: A skill you asked Record to add (POST /skill-requests); cannot be verified

skills.description: 5 to 10 recommended; fewer than 5 is a warning

key.description: Your id for the question; answers come back under it

type.description: yes_no = a Yes / No question; voice = the candidate answers in their own words

knockout.description: yes_no only: the answer ("yes" or "no") that marks the candidate not qualified

enrichment_questions.description: 0 to 5 enrichment questions (up to 10 when data_enrichment is the only method)

interest_collection.description: `other_roles` is only saved and returned. It does not change what candidates are asked: the interest prompt is fixed, and `methods` switches it on or off.

job_id.description: Optional: your own id for the job, kept with the mandate and returned as job_id. Leave it out to work with mandate_id alone

example.title: Warehouse Associate (Forklift)
example.description: Pick, pack and load orders in a busy warehouse. Forklift licence preferred.

enrichment_questions.text: Do you hold a valid forklift licence?
Tell us in your own words why you want this job.

202.description: Accepted: the mandate exists and its questions are being prepared

job_id.description: Your job id; null for a mandate created without one (it is known by its mandate_id)

changed.description: false when the same mandate was sent again

400.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: Unknown skill, `verify` on a skill that cannot be verified, repeated skill / question key, a check without its data, `abroad` without `countries` (or with `location`), `countries` on an India job, an unknown or non-selectable country code, or experience above 50 years.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: That workflow was made in the playground.

409.description: `CONFLICT`: Workflow is archived, or `job_id` is already used.

422.description: `LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: More than 10 skills, 3 verified skills or 5 questions.
